scope: Workflow addendum distilled from the live SGA5 p234 source-audit/workpass lane. This belongs on the workflow/replication record as method guidance, not on the SGA record as a reader or certification.

source_evidence.observed_scope: Local SGA5 workpass around Expose V p234; 234 pages inspected, 21 TeX fixes plus one cosmetic fix, 38 source typos tracked, 8 TeX content errors found and fixed, 136 diagrams tracked.

workflow_lessons: Use source glyph inspection at sufficient zoom before changing symbols, labels, subscripts, diagram edges, or suspicious words.
Classify discrepancies as editor/transcription errors, copied source typos, source oddities, false flags, or layout/cosmetic issues before editing.
Agent and OCR findings are useful finders, not authorities.
Build-clean TeX and compiled PDFs are not source-fidelity certificates.
Public archive records should separate page-local workpass status, source-audit evidence, reader quality, and critical-edition claims.
caveats: This addendum does not certify SGA5.
This addendum does not promote the SGA5 p234 workpass as a public reader.
The SGA5 workpass remains live local repair/provenance evidence until a compact package is deliberately built and reviewed.
next_action: Include this addendum in the next workflow/replication Zenodo refresh and keep the SGA5 p234 checkpoint on the SGA record as local provenance only.
